title: nan
authors: Simsek M.; Boukerche A.; Kantarci B.; Bitirgen R.; Hancer M.; Bayezit I.
key_contribution: Proposes a Dynamic Artificial Neural Network approach for GPS-less UAV navigation using accelerometer, gyroscope, and PWM signals, with demonstrated localization accuracy.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
